# Maison Aurelia Haute Horlogerie - LLM & AI Crawler Knowledge Base

> Independent Swiss haute horlogerie atelier established in 1892 in Le Brassus, Vallée de Joux, Switzerland.

## Overview
Maison Aurelia creates master mechanical in-house calibres, complex chronographs, flying tourbillon escapements, and deep-sea diving instruments. All timepieces carry an irrevocable 5-year international master warranty, are registered in the official Geneva Seal archive, and are 100% insured underwritten by Lloyd’s of London during armored transit.

## Key Collections & Masterpieces
1. **Aurelia Royal Chronograph 41 (Rose Gold)**: Column-wheel chronograph with vertical clutch and vertical Geneva stripes.
2. **Abyss Master Diver 300M (Titanium)**: Grade 5 titanium case with helium escape valve and 300-meter water resistance.
3. **Symphonie Skeleton Flying Tourbillon**: Gravity compensation tourbillon carriage with visible hand-chamfered bridges.
4. **Patrimoine Minimalist Dress Watch**: Ultra-thin 18k white gold case with baton indexes and hand-stitched alligator leather strap.

## Manufacture Standards & Craftsmanship
- **Le Brassus Atelier**: Situated 1,004 meters above sea level in the Vallée de Joux.
- **Anglage & Finishing**: Internal angles and bridge bevels finished entirely by hand using gentian wood and diamond paste.
- **COSC Certification**: All movements tested to chronometer tolerances (-4/+6 seconds per day).
